args.code: (() => { try { const save = localStorage.getItem("farm_game_save_v1"); const data = JSON.parse(save); const npcFriends = data.npcFriendship || {}; const npcList = []; for (const k in npcFriends) { npcList.push({name: k, value: npcFriends[k]}); } npcList.sort((a,b) => b.value - a.value); const events = data.eventHistory || []; const evtSample = events.slice(-10).map(e => e.type || e.name || JSON.stringify(e).slice(0,50)); const fields = data.fields || []; const fieldInfo = fields.map(f => ({id: f.id, crop: f.crop || null, stage: f.stage, level: f.level})); const skills = data.skills || {}; const skillInfo = {}; for (const k in skills) { const v = skills[k]; skillInfo[k] = typeof v === "number" ? v : (v.level !== undefined ? v.level : v); } const milestones = data.unlockedMilestones || []; const tasks = data.activeTasks || []; const features = data.unlockedFeatures || []; return JSON.stringify({npcList: npcList.slice(0,10), npcCount: npcList.length, eventCount: events.length, evtSample: evtSample, fieldInfo: fieldInfo, skillInfo: skillInfo, milestoneCount: milestones.length, taskCount: tasks.length, featureCount: features.length, features: features.slice(0,20), daysPlayed: data.daysPlayed, day: data.day, season: data.season, weather: data.currentWeather, money: data.money, stamina: data.stamina, health: data.health, reputation: data.reputation, mood: data.mood, research: data.researchPoints, storage: data.storageCapacity, totalHarvest: data.totalHarvested, totalSold: data.totalSold, disasterRate: data.disasterRate, gameSpeed: data.gameSpeed, mode: data.mode, tutorialStep: data.tutorialStep, currentEvent: data.currentEvent, saveVersion: data.saveVersion, pets: data.pets, inventory: data.inventory}); } catch(e) { return JSON.stringify({error: e.message}); } })()
